text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa won the Chunichi Shimbun 
Hai. She thanked and encouraged Tosen 
Jordan, who recovered thanks to her 
running, telling her to "Keep living."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Nakayama Festa learned the 
truth. Her former homeroom teacher had 
chosen surgery over palliative care... all 
to watch more of their former student's 
races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa had won the bet. She was 
able to become her former homeroom 
teacher's hope for living.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next goal is the Takarazuka Kinen, 
loved by my former homeroom teacher. I 
promised to show them what I look like 
taking 1st place.
